third_party_relationship.description: Use unrelated only where the lack of contractual/commercial relationship is established.

invoice_mismatch.description: True only after structured reconciliation identifies a material mismatch.

route_mismatch.description: True only when the actual payment or shipment route is inconsistent with the documented underlying trade.

expected_monthly_volume.description: The customer's DECLARED expected monthly volume (AED) from the KYC profile. Drives the PROFILE_DEVIATION rule; absent = rule does not run.

payment_message.description: Raw SWIFT MT103 or ISO 20022 pacs.008 message for this payment. When present, payment_screen.py screens every party it names.

parties.description: Payment parties when no raw message is available. Each party is name-screened against the sanctions lists and country-checked.

remittance_info.description: Payment reference / remittance text; scanned for designated names embedded in it.

weight_g.description: Metal weight in grams. With transaction_type buy|sell, drives RAPID_RESALE (same gold bought and sold back within days).

purpose.description: Stated payment purpose; scanned with remittance_info by REFERENCE_KEYWORD (commission / consultancy, charity / NPO, hawala wording).

personal_account_for_corporate.description: True only when a corporate transaction is recorded as paid from a personal account (PERSONAL_ACCOUNT).

source_of_funds_verified.description: False when the source of funds is recorded as NOT verified; on cash at/above the CDD trigger, drives CASH_NO_SOURCE_OF_FUNDS.

red_flags.description: STR red-flag codes a person recorded on the payment (data/str-red-flags.json); each becomes a RED_FLAG alert.
